comment: Trigger boundary for Java/JVM source and build work versus frameworks and generic repository workflows.

queries.query: Fix equals and hashCode for this Java value type used only by Java callers; no Kotlin source or Kotlin-facing contract is involved.
Make this Maven module compile for the repository's Java 17 runtime without changing the parent toolchain.
Add a command to this Gradle-built Java service that reads order IDs from a file and fetches each order's status through the existing blocking billing client.

Repair this Java ProcessBuilder wrapper so a child that floods both redirected streams cannot deadlock and timeout cleanup leaves no owned process or drainer; no shell source or shell parsing is changing.
Use $java-development to review this CompletableFuture error path and its JUnit tests.
Explain a Spring Boot actuator property; no Java source or build files are changing.
Create a release branching policy for this Java repository without touching the build or source.
Change a Spring Java service method's public API and update its transaction boundary.
Change a public Java interface and its Kotlin implementation's nullability contract, preserving the JVM signatures used by supported Java and Kotlin callers.
